column3: Held up towards back of pack - pushed along and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to close finish - got up in final strides to win
Handy early - roused along with 2f left - hit front inside final furlong - battled on gamely - caught close to line - beaten a neck
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on inside the last - grabbed third close home but couldn't find more
Set the pace - pressure applied over 2f out - passed over 1f out - dropped away before rallying inside the final furlong - couldn't reach the first two and fourth at the line
Held up towards back and pulling hard early - pressed for effort with 1f left - found some late progress but not enough to get involved - stayed on to finish fifth beaten 2.5 lengths
settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on inside the final furlong - unable to get involved with the leading group - finished off well for sixth
Sluggish start - fought for control racing among the pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost momentum then held steady gait to finish 7th beaten 3 lengths
Sluggish start - stayed at the back throughout - never a factor - finished 8th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - lost touch inside final furlong and finished well beaten
Handy position wide out - pushed along with 3f left - fell away inside final furlong to finish tenth well beaten
Sluggish start - held up at the rear the whole way - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack - pushed along and moved through inside final furlong - hit front close home to score
Held up in the pack - pushed along a furlong out - found extra close home to move into second - narrowly missed out at the line
Set the pace from the off - roused along with over 2f left - pressed hard inside the final furlong - weakened close home dropping to third
Took a strong hold early - sat close to the front - urged along over 2f out - responded briefly before fading in the last furlong - held on for fourth without finding more
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along a furlong out then dropped away fast approaching the final furlong - held no more in reserve to finish fifth beaten 4 lengths
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early on - up with the front group - pushed along with 2f left before fading inside the final furlong to finish 6th
Settled towards the back early - unable to land a blow in the finish - eventually came home well beaten in 7th
Held up in eagerness early - stayed towards the back for the duration - unable to make an impression - finished well held in 8th
Held up towards the back early - made ground three out - urged forward approaching two out - driven approaching the final furlong - hit the front close home - stayed on strongly to assert at the line
Sent clear from the break - urged along with 2f left - pushed out approaching final furlong - challenged inside the last - overtaken close home - stuck on for second
Held up at the back - pushed along and losing touch 3f out - made progress 2f out without threatening leaders - closed only in the closing strides to end up third
Held a spot near the front - pushed along with 2f left - still in with a shout inside the final furlong - maintained effort without finding more and edged out of third close home
Travelled keenly early - sat close to the pace - pressed for effort with over 2f left - found nothing and lost place inside final 2f - slipped to rear approaching the line
Held up at the back - improved into contention 3f out before fading quickly - allowed to drop away 2f out
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - battled on strongly close home - edged clear right on the line
Settled towards the back and wide of midfield - pushed along with a furlong to travel - surged late in the closing stages - grabbed second right on the line - unable to get past the winner
Sent forward eagerly early - hit front but soon overtaken and stayed close up - roused along with 3f left - stayed on around a furlong out - weakened near the line - edged out for second close home
Held a midpack position early - roused with 3f left - edged wide and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth without threatening the front
Up with the front group - nudged forward 2f out and quickly left behind - rallied inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - pushed along to make progress a furlong out - stayed on level terms to the line for sixth
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front after 1f - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost command inside final 2f - dropped away close home to finish seventh
Held up towards the back from the off - unable to challenge for the remainder - beaten into 8th
Settled at the back from the off - never involved with the front runners - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back of the pack early - stayed there through the middle stages - never got involved and finished well held in 10th
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along and made ground 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong - drifted right approaching the line - held on for the win
Settled at back early - stuck for space and made ground 2f out before angling right for a run - pressed clear leader inside final furlong but unable to get past - finished second
Hampered start - tracked front pair - pressed for effort over 2f out and hit front - overtaken inside final furlong - held on for third at the line
Set the pace early - pressed for effort with over two furlongs left and soon overtaken - lost touch quickly - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Keen early - held a spot in the pack on the outside - pressed for effort with 2f left - drifted left approaching the final furlong and couldn't find more - finished 5th

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - travelled up handy - found nowhere to go and drifted right approaching 2f out - pressed for effort with nothing to give - hampered inside final furlong - dropped away and finished sixth
Set the pace from the start - pushed along with two furlongs left before drawing away - won going away with ease
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - responded inside final furlong but couldn't get on terms - finished second
Settled in the pack - pushed along to make progress from 2f out - kept on to finish third without further improvement
Held up towards the back - urged forward 3f out - lost touch with leaders - kept on at one gear through the closing stages for fourth
Sluggish start - settled at the rear - unable to get involved - finished 5th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with over 2f left - dropped away quickly and finished well beaten - eventually home sixth

Settled in the pack early - urged forward and moved through when angled left with 3f left - asked for effort 2f out - powered to the front inside the final furlong and pulled away easily in the closing stages
Sat just behind pace early - hit front 3f out - pushed along approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on for second
Poor start cost significant ground - urged forward 3f out - progress from 2f out but unable to threaten leaders - stayed on late to grab third
Up with the front group - niggled into contention from 3f out - driven over 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Set the tempo from the off - lost command 3f out - pushed along inside final two furlongs and holding position - unable to find more close home finished fifth
Settled in the pack early - urged forward and made progress 3f out - driven from 2f out but found little approaching the final furlong - stayed on same pace to finish sixth
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along and lost touch over 2f out then well held to finish 7th
Keen early tracking the front rank - urged forward 3f out - dropped back 2f out - faded late to finish well beaten
Keen to go early - settled mid-pack - pressed for effort 3f from home and soon lost touch - finished well held in 9th

Set the pace early - lost the front spot approaching 3f out but stayed close - pushed along to regain command inside the final furlong - drifted right but continued finding more - pulled clear near the line to score
Pulled hard - up with early leaders - pushed along 2f out and edged left over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening for second
Settled among the back markers early - pushed along with two furlongs left then found some late progress inside the final furlong - never able to threaten and came home third
Settled in mid-division - pushed off the bridle from 3f out - made ground over 1f out - found little in the closing stages and beaten 3¼ lengths in 4th

Drifted right at the off - settled up in rear pulling hard - driven forward to hit the front 3f out - pushed clear approaching 2f out - passed and squeezed for room a furlong out then dropped away rapidly
Held up close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong - finished 6th
Sluggish to break and settled at the back - keen early - improved and shifted right approaching 3f out - pushed along over 1f out - powered home in the closing stages to get up right on the line
Tracked pace early - asked for effort 3f out and hit front approaching final 2f - stayed on strongly into last furlong before being caught close to home

Travelled keenly towards the back - moved into contention and edged right approaching 2f out - driven and drifted left inside final 2f - stayed on strongly into the last furlong - couldn't find more and dropped to third close home
Held up at the back - driven up 3f out - made progress under pressure over 2f out - ran on inside final furlong but squeezed for space near the line - unable to get back on terms
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on inside the final furlong but flattened out close home
Held a forward position early - pushed along 3f out - found progress hampered for room inside final 2f - stayed on to finish sixth beaten 2.5 lengths
Set the pace early - pushed along under pressure 3f out - overtaken approaching 2f out but still in contention with a furlong left - faded inside final furlong to finish 7th
Held up in the pack early - urged forward 3f out - driven with two furlongs left but failed to fire - slipped to the rear inside the final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack early - moved into second by halfway - shaken up to hit the front approaching 2f out - edged clear inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Slow to break - settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong and a half but unable to reel in winner
Settled in the pack - still 9th at halfway - eased across to the left and asked for effort 3f out - moved into 4th under pressure inside final furlong and finished with running to spare
Towards the back of the pack - 10th at halfway - niggled into contention from 3f out - picked up from over 1f out - finished 4th but position was as good as it got
Set the pace early - two lengths clear at halfway - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside the last furlong and a half - lost touch through the closing stages to finish fifth
Handy early - 4th at halfway - driven approaching final 2f and held effort to finish sixth
Handy early - slipped to 6th by halfway - driven approaching 2f out - faded inside the final furlong - finished well held in 7th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - urged into a rally from over 2f out - couldn't threaten the leading group late on
Held up at the back - urged forward before 3f out - maintained effort to the line without threatening the front
Settled in the pack early - 8th at halfway - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well held
Handy early - slipped to 7th by halfway - urged on with three left - lost touch approaching final furlong and finished well beaten
Settled at the back early - never a factor with the pack - lost touch through the race - well beaten at the finish in 12th
Close up early - held 4th at halfway before fading 4f out - beaten a long way at the finish
Held up towards back of pack pulling hard early - improved position out wide from halfway - closed on front-runners with a furlong left - hit front inside final 110yds - drew clear for the win
Handy up with the pace - lost momentum two out - found renewed energy and edged towards the middle a furlong out - closed on the front-runner inside the final stage - grabbed second close home

Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - made progress into the final furlongs - boxed in and short of space with a furlong to run - briefly up to second inside the last 110yds before fading to finish third
Sent clear from the off - urged into action 2f out - driven approaching final furlong - overtaken close home - lost ground late to finish fourth
Held up early - improved into contention 2f out and closed on front pack 1f out - lost momentum inside final 110yds to finish 5th
Settled around mid-pack early - lost touch and slipped towards the back before halfway - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Close up early and pushed into second - drifted left short of room a furlong out - faded to the back and finished in seventh
Held up towards the back and wide - fighting for control early - slipped to last approaching 2f out - lost touch with rivals a furlong out - stayed on steadily to finish eighth
Held up in the pack - steered to the near rail after 5f and moved into third over 6f out - flowing progress to the front over 3f out - drew away 2f out - hands-and-heels to the line
Handy early - shifted wide after 5f - up with rivals inside final 8f - hit front 4f out - driven and overtaken 3f out then no match for dominant winner
Sluggish break - settled just off the pace within range - moved into third with 3f left - pressed on but couldn't land a blow - finished third
Sent forward early to dictate - shaken up before losing command 4f out - dropped away soon after - held on for 4th
Sat just behind the front group - pressed for effort with 3f left - had no answer soon after and dropped away well beaten in 5th
Restrained in rear - pushed along 4f out - quickly outpaced and well adrift in 6th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to hold the field
Settled just behind the front group - roused along with 2f left - closed in and challenged approaching the final furlong - stayed on to the line - edged into second but unable to get past the winner
Took a strong hold early - sat handy with leaders - pushed along and gained ground inside final two furlongs - stayed on gamely approaching the last furlong - edged out close home to finish third
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort 2f out - lost touch soon after - dropped away steadily inside final furlong to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along approaching 3f out and unable to quicken - dropped away then held on without further progress late
Held up at the back early - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Pulled hard early - settled at the back - made no impression - well held in 7th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back for the whole race - well held by the finish
Tracked pace-setter early - pushed along with 2f left - drifted left approaching final furlong - finished strongly to hit front close home - won comfortably

Settled in the pack early - urged forward 3f out - checked in stride over 2f out - drifted left approaching the final furlong - baulked once more close home - stayed on nicely to the line but not quite good enough

Held up towards the back - driven into contention 3f out - hit front just after halfway point of final 2f - firmly urged with over a furlong left - stayed on inside final furlong before being overtaken close home - edged out of second near the line
Held up at back - urged forward 3f out and steered right 2f out - unable to threaten leaders 1f out - closed strongly in the last furlong to finish fourth beaten 2 lengths

Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - urged into effort with 3f left - baulked and knocked about approaching final 2f - drifted markedly left inside the last but stayed on - unable to find more close home
Held mid-pack early - driven and lost touch with leading group 3f out - stayed on at one pace to finish sixth
Drifted right at the outset - settled in the pack - driven along and wandered off a straight line approaching 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong and finished well held
Travelled keenly early - close to the pace - checked by contact 2f out and unable to regain momentum - dropped away final furlong to finish eighth
Travelled keenly early - hit front - pressed on then lost command over 2f out - soon struggling and faded meekly through final furlong
Held mid-pack early - under pressure and lacking room approaching 3f out - driven from 2f out with nothing left to give - slipped to last approaching the final furlong
Settled in midfield taking a strong hold - 8th at the halfway point - urged forward approaching the final furlong - driven inside the last - hit the front close home - stayed on strongly to score

Settled 7th at halfway - denied a gap and angled left 2f out - progress over 1f out and hit the front inside the final furlong - passed inside the last 150 yards and unable to peg back the winner - went down by a length
Held a forward spot early - fourth at halfway - moved through to hit the front two out - pushed on approaching the final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to find more
Settled in the pack early - 5th at halfway - found running but squeezed for space against the rail 2f out - shifted left and pushed for late effort - kept going strongly to finish 4th
Held up handy early - disputing second at the midpoint before asked for effort 2f out - lost ground inside final furlong to finish 5th
Sat close up early - third at halfway then driven when attempting to strike 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - ninth at halfway - urged forward two out - stayed on at one gear through the finish without threatening
Settled midpack early - 6th at halfway - urged forward and gained ground 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong and beaten well
Held up towards the back - still 10th at halfway - urged forward with 2f left before staying on at one gait to finish 9th
Held up in the pack - driven and edged forward from 2f out - always well off the pace - finished tenth beaten well
Stood up on jumping off - settled towards the back - never involved in the finish - well beaten in 11th
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out before being overtaken - knocked off stride and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Slow to begin - stayed towards the back - never involved - finished well held
Held up towards back of field - pushed for effort but faded 2f out - always struggling to get involved - finished well beaten in 14th
Refused to line up - took no part

Settled up with pace early - moved ahead by the 1f marker - pushed along after being overtaken with a furlong left - fought back to regain command inside final 110yds - stayed on to prevail by a whisker
Went straight to front - lost that spot by a whisker after 1f - urged forward with 2f remaining - regained command a furlong out - driven when overtaken close home then held on without finding more
Settled in third early - urged forward with two furlongs left - closed on front-running duo inside the last - stayed on without further improvement to secure third at the line
Settled at the back early - driven up to join the front group from 2f out - stayed on well but narrowly denied third close home
Hesitant start - settled at the back - unable to live with the pace 3f out - dropped further back 2f out - allowed to drift home well beaten
Settled in the pack early - pushed along to move through into contention two out then went in front approaching the last furlong - kept finding more to the line
Settled at back early - pushed along with 2f left - crept through wide a furlong out - finished well to take second late but no threat to winner
Settled in the pack early - driven up into contention 2f out - kept on to move into third inside the final furlong - clung on for the placing at the finish
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final 2f before finding extra late gears - edged closer inside final furlong but couldn't quite catch third home
Sat close to the pace - roused to hit the front over a furlong out then lost command approaching the final furlong - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 5th
Set the pace early - driven to keep going 2f out before giving way approaching the final furlong - lost place late to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along and faded from the front group with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished seventh
Settled towards the back - asked for effort over 2f out and hampered for room - shifted right to find space and gained ground - kept in check from the final furlong to finish 8th
Held up mid-pack - pressed for pace with two furlongs left - unable to close the gap - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to respond and beaten into 10th
Sluggish beginning - settled at the back of the field - pushed along with two furlongs left but unable to land a blow - finished well beaten in 11th
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along with two furlongs left - no impact on the finish - eventually well beaten in 12th
Held up close to the pace early - urged along with 2f left - form gave way in a hurry - beaten a long way at the finish
Took a strong hold early - set the pace throughout - pushed along a furlong out - powered clear to the line
Sat close to the pace early - pushed to challenge the front-runner 2f out - looked poised to win inside the final furlong - lost momentum late and beaten three-quarters of a length
Held up towards the back - pushed along with over two furlongs left - eased across left and made progress up the rail inside final furlong - stayed on close home to finish third
Sluggish start - trailed at rear - roused with two furlongs left - responded before finding a rewarding surge in the final furlong - couldn't get on terms - finished fourth a length down
Racing handy in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - faded inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up early - eager in outlook - stayed towards back of field - never got competitive - well held at finish
Held up towards the back - made no impact through the contest - finished well held in 7th
Settled with eagerness in the pack - pushed to go the pace 3f out then urged forward 2f out - dropped away and beaten well
Pushed up wide in touch with the pack until a furlong out - urged approaching 2f out - dropped away quickly and finished last
Set the pace from the off - clear throughout with no serious pressure - saw it out comfortably for the win
Travelled keenly early - sat third - improved but boxed in over 2f out - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on at one speed close home - never able to challenge for the win
Held up at back - urged forward 3f out - driven with 2f to run - failed to threaten leaders 1f out - stayed on modestly late to finish third
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward 3f out - asked for effort 2f out but found little - slipped to the back inside the final furlong
Handy in the pack early - 4th at halfway - driven on over 3f out - hampered for room and moved left 2f out - urged inside final furlong - hit front close home and stayed on strongly
Settled in the pack and wide early - 9th at halfway - urged forward from 3f out - stayed under pressure to close 1f out - hit the front inside the last - caught in the final strides to finish second
Towards the rear in 8th at halfway and given a squeeze - denied a gap and angled left a furlong out - kept on strongly inside the final 150 yards to take 3rd but just held by the front pair
Handy early - fifth at halfway - urged forward with 2f left - hit the front for a moment inside final furlong - overtaken again and stayed on at one gait to the line finishing 4th
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - pressure applied from 2f out - found little and dropped away inside the final 100 yards

Settled in the pack - 11th at halfway - urged forward after 3f out - asked for effort with 2f left - shifted left approaching final furlong then found running room restricted late but kept finding late - finished 6th beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - still 12th at halfway - urged forward with 3f left - driven approaching 2f out - made late progress inside the last - kept on without threatening the front - finished 7th
Slow to break - settled midfield - 7th at halfway - urged into effort with 2f left - found brief improvement approaching final furlong before fading to finish 8th
Tardy leaving stalls - settled at the back - niggled into contention from 3f out - picked up inside the final furlong to make late ground - closest of those behind at the line
Set the pace - relinquished the lead at halfway - came under pressure from 2f out - faded in the final furlong and finished well held in 10th
Sat close up early holding keen rhythm - third at halfway - pushed to reach the front pair two out - dropped away fast inside final furlong to finish 11th
Sat close to front - moved into command at halfway - lost control briefly with over 2f left and lost the advantage - dropped away steadily from a furlong out to finish 12th
Held up at back - asked for effort 3f out - lost footing briefly with 2f left - faded inside final furlong - well held at finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - urged forward approaching halfway - made a little progress when asked for effort 2f out - lost ground final furlong and finished well beaten in 14th
Held up towards the back - gap of three lengths off the pace by halfway - unable to challenge - well held in 15th
Held up at the back - pushed along from halfway - never a factor and finished well beaten
Led throughout from the off - controlled the tempo - picked up 2f out - opened a gap inside the last furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Handy early - into second past halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - battling for spot inside final furlong - responded to keep on but couldn't reel in winner

Settled at the back and detached from the pace early - driven up from 4f out - challenged for second spot just past the 1f marker - unable to match the front two inside the final furlong and faded into third
Settled in second early - dropped away past halfway - wide rounding the bend and pursuing the front three from beyond 1f out - plugged on without finding more to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - slipped to last before halfway - lost touch from over 4f out and well held at the finish
Held up mid-pack - asked for effort inside final furlong and edged right for room - powered clear late to hit the front close home - drew off to score
Sat close to pace early - pushed to go up over 1f out and edged in front - caught right on the line to finish second
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - made progress a furlong out - closed inside final 110yds but denied late to finish third
Went straight to the front - lost command a furlong out and gave way close home
Settled mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 3f left - unable to land a blow thereafter - finished fifth
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a blow - finished sixth
Held up handy early - driven to loom up with under a furlong left - gave way close home
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - faded from there to finish eighth
Broke straight to the front and dictated the tempo - pushed along when challenged 2f out - drifted left approaching the final furlong - stayed on under pressure to the line
Held up mid-pack - pushed along and made progress over 2f out with little threat - finished strongly last furlong to go down by under two lengths
Handy near front early - urged forward 3f out - challenged winner 2f out - drifted left approaching final furlong - held effort through closing stages but yielded second close home
Held up at back - pushed along and lost touch 3f out - drifted left inside final 2f - kept on without threatening finishing 4th
Sluggish start - settled mid-pack - driven and left behind 3f out - urged 2f out - found nothing thereafter - well held in 5th
Settled in the pack - lost touch and asked for effort 3f out - no headway made 2f out - slipped to the back inside the final furlong to finish well held
Settled midfield early - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out - found extra close home to hit the front inside the final furlong
Settled midpack early - third at halfway - pushed to improve over 2f out - hit the front approaching final furlong before being overtaken inside it - stayed on for second
Slow to break - held up in the pack - 6th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - finished with late progress into third
Tracked the front rank early - second at halfway - hit the front two furlongs out - pressed for effort a furlong out but faded fast - finished well held in 4th
Went straight to front and travelled keenly - driven when overtaken with 2f remaining - lost place inside final furlong - well held in 5th
Reared as stalls opened - dropped to last and made gradual progress to 7th at halfway - pushed into contention over 2f out but found nothing and faded in the final furlong - well held in 6th
Held up at the back - lost more ground and needed urging around halfway - well beaten by the finish - eventually seventh
Held a forward spot early - fourth at halfway before fading fast from 3f out - finished well adrift in 8th
Set the pace from the break - asked for effort inside final two furlongs - kept finding more to prevail
Sluggish start - dropped in towards back - made progress into contention with 2f left - moved up to second a furlong out - pressed on but couldn't get closer to leader late
Settled in third early - drifted wide and slipped back approaching 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong - responded late to grab third close home
Settled second early - dropped back from over 2f out - faded through the final furlong to finish fourth
Sluggish start - stayed towards the back and never landed a blow - dropped further adrift approaching final furlong to finish fifth
Sat behind pace - driven approaching final furlong - hit front inside last - held rivals' late challenge to score
Sat close to front pair - pushed along a furlong out - closed strongly in the final stages - edged out by a whisker
pulled hard early - travelled close to front - hit the front 3f out - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - stayed on same rhythm to finish third
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left then finished strongly late - narrowly denied third
Settled at the back early - pushed along with two furlongs left - moved through faded runners late but always short of a real chance
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - unable to respond then well beaten - finished sixth
Set the pace early - lost front spot 3f out then driven back in front 2f out - overtaken again inside final furlong - lost ground final 110yds finishing 7th
Settled at the back early - asked for effort with two furlongs left - crept into it late but no real threat to those in front
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - had little response and dropped away
settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away soon after - finished well held in 10th
Up with the pace - 3rd at halfway - driven and moved left 2f out - urged over 1f out - stayed on strongly to hit the front near the line
Sat close to pace early - second at halfway - pushed for effort 2f out - hit front inside final 100 yards - caught late and unable to find more
Held up towards the back of the pack - 8th at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out - made progress under pressure with a furlong left - kept going strongly to close late for third
Up with the early leaders - 4th at halfway - pressure applied from 3f out - plugged on at one speed from 2f out without threatening
Set the pace early - driven on with over 2f left before being outrun in the final furlong to finish 5th
Held a central position early - 6th at halfway - given encouragement approaching the last two furlongs - eased into stride under pressure a furlong out then found nothing and dropped away close home
Settled midfield early - 7th at the halfway point - urged on with 2f left - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Wide and keen early - held a handy position and 5th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out - lost ground inside final 2f - allowed to drop away approaching the last furlong - well held at finish
Settled towards the back - failed to land a blow - beaten a long way when eased through the finish
Hampered start - settled last - never a factor - well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - urged forward 3f out - dropped away over 1f later and finished well behind

Hesitant start and settled last - urged into contention two out - closed on the front group approaching final furlong - stayed on well through the last furlong - hit the front close home - drew clear at the finish
front early - urged forward with two out - opened a two length advantage inside final furlong - lost momentum and overhauled close home - beaten into second
Held up mid-pack - moved into second and driven on approaching 2f out - unable to match front two inside final 110yds
Sluggish start at the back - urged forward approaching 3f out - responded with mild progress inside final furlong to take fourth - stayed on same effort to the line
Settled just behind the pace early - driven and dropped back approaching final 2f - faded rapidly inside final furlong - eventually finished 5th
Held a forward spot early but wide of rivals - lost touch with the pace over 2f out - dropped right away in the closing stages - well held in 6th
Handy early - roused into second inside final furlong - hit front late to score
